title: Post-incident timeline completeness
summary: Share of closed incidents whose post-incident review timeline artifact carries no flagged evidence gap. A timeline-collation step that consumes the upstream anti-forensics / audit-tampering Sigma references and finds no gap signal in the incident window sets `__evidence_gaps_present__` to false; the metric tracks the rolling proportion of such runs. Lower-quality evidence (Sigma references triggered in the incident window) is not a failure of the review — the review template still records the decisions taken under partial evidence — but the KPI lets the programme watch how often it operates with full vs. partial evidence.

target.rationale: ENISA good-practice baseline for evidence-completeness on post-incident reviews.

measurement.formula: count( runs where __evidence_gaps_present__ == false ) / count( runs in window )

inputs.name: playbook_run
inputs.description: timeline-collation step records evidence-gap flag at completion

external_refs.name: ENISA — Good Practices for Supply Chain Cybersecurity
